certification_states.description: Every drill passed against current evidence and the effective posture equals the published ceiling.
At least one narrowing reason fired; the effective posture is below the published ceiling. A claim-bearing narrowed row holds promotion.
The row narrowed to the undeclared-badge floor. It asserts no low-power claim and is retained only for diagnosis.

claim_levels.description: A low-power badge with no materialized efficiency-state evidence. Asserts no claim and is retained only for diagnosis.
claim_levels.label: Undeclared badge

claim_levels.description: The efficiency state and source-of-change are materialized, but hidden-work suppression or protected-path preservation is not qualified. Not a publishable low-power claim.
claim_levels.label: State declared

claim_levels.description: A claim-bearing posture: the subject materializes its state, names shed work, suppresses hidden-pane render and polling, and preserves protected paths under pressure.
claim_levels.label: Qualified low-power

claim_levels.description: The highest claim-bearing posture: qualified low-power plus policy-aware override, staged recovery, and propagation to every required release, support, docs, and help surface.
claim_levels.label: Certified low-power

drills.label: Efficiency-state behavior
drills.proves: The subject materializes inspectable efficiency-state transitions with a named state, source-of-change, and a recorded reason for every reduced surface.

drills.label: Hidden-work suppression
drills.proves: Hidden, occluded, and off-screen panes commit no render work and pause nonessential polling and animation.

drills.label: Protected-path preservation
drills.proves: Active tasks, debug correctness, local save, navigation, and review authority stay protected at every step under pressure.

drills.label: Session-aware shedding
drills.proves: Optional assists shed before any live run's correctness or authority regresses, and a material downgrade is warned about before it applies.

drills.label: Staged recovery
drills.proves: When pressure clears, deferred work resumes in staged order rather than thrashing back at once.

evidence_kinds.description: An over-time energy/thermal lab trace driving the canonical runtime through battery and thermal transitions.
A hidden-pane render audit proving hidden, occluded, or off-screen panes commit no paint and pause polling and animation.
An active-session pressure posture proving optional work sheds before any live run's correctness or authority regresses.

inspection.freshness_rule: Bound evidence is current within 30 days of the packet as_of; older evidence is stale, an absent required-drill binding is partial when other evidence exists and missing otherwise.
inspection.how_to_recompute: For each row, grade every required drill's evidence freshness against the packet as_of, run the drill predicate on current evidence, fire the implied narrowing reasons, set the effective posture to the lowest of the published ceiling and each fired reason's floor, derive the certification state, then resolve the promotion gate.
inspection.promotion_rule: Promotion proceeds unless a row whose published ceiling is claim-bearing narrows below that ceiling.

narrowing_reasons.detects: A required drill has no current efficiency-state, hidden-pane, or session evidence bound to it.
narrowing_reasons.stop_rule: Quarantine the row to the undeclared-badge floor; it may assert no low-power claim without current evidence.

narrowing_reasons.detects: Bound evidence is older than the freshness window, so the claim would outrun its measurement.
narrowing_reasons.stop_rule: Narrow below a publishable claim until fresh evidence is captured; an old measurement does not certify a current claim.

narrowing_reasons.detects: The subject binds some required evidence but not every drill's, so coverage is incomplete.
narrowing_reasons.stop_rule: Narrow below a publishable claim until every required drill is backed by current evidence.

narrowing_reasons.detects: A hidden, occluded, or off-screen pane committed paint or kept polling under pressure.
narrowing_reasons.stop_rule: Narrow below a publishable claim until hidden-pane suppression is qualified under pressure.

narrowing_reasons.detects: A protected interaction or durability invariant regressed under battery or thermal pressure.
narrowing_reasons.stop_rule: Narrow below a publishable claim until protected paths are preserved under pressure.

narrowing_reasons.detects: A live run lost correctness or authority before its optional work shed, or a material downgrade applied without a warning.
narrowing_reasons.stop_rule: Narrow below a publishable claim until optional work demonstrably sheds first and downgrades are warned.

narrowing_reasons.detects: Deferred work resumed without a staged-recovery transition after pressure cleared.
narrowing_reasons.stop_rule: Narrow to qualified low-power until staged recovery is proven.

promotion_gate.rationale: Promotion holds when any row whose published ceiling is claim-bearing narrows below that ceiling because a required drill failed or its evidence is stale, partial, or missing.

publication_bindings.ingests: The promotion decision, blocking rows, and each row's certification state and effective posture.
Drill outcomes, freshness grades, and effective postures only — never raw traces or content.

summary: Each claimed laptop-or-desktop profile and long-running M5 surface family runs a fixed drill set — efficiency-state behavior, hidden-work suppression, protected-path preservation, session-aware shedding, and staged recovery — against current energy/thermal traces, hidden-pane audits, and session-pressure postures. Stale, partial, or missing evidence and any failed drill narrow the row's claim and fire the promotion gate, so a low-power claim can never outrun the evidence behind it. Release, support, docs, and help consume this packet instead of cloning a low-power claim.
